content: GPL clean-room (opensource.stackexchange, softwareengineering.SE consensus): copyright covers EXPRESSION (source code), not ideas/functionality/architecture — copying ideas and patterns from a GPL app into a differently-licensed project is legally fine; copying code is not. Reading GPL code then reimplementing risks disputes, so clean-room (never read the code, work from docs/behavior) is the cautious practice. Folder-structure copying is a gray zone. For dicta: FlClash GPL — take the architectural pattern (separate core process, socket/named-pipe JSON IPC, tray+hotkeys approach) and the visual design language only; never open/copy its Dart or Rust source.
